source.description:
PROBLEM: `bd dolt push` in core fails: "Error: dangling chunk reference: aborting push to prevent propagating corrupt chunks". The beads pre-push hook therefore aborts every git push (beads sync gate). Session context: long bd session with schema-skew warnings (binary v53 vs db v65) all day; corruption surfaced 2026-08-28 during first push attempt. Git pushes currently bypass via --no-verify (used for integration branch pushes; PR flow unaffected).
EVIDENCE: bd dolt push output (dangling chunk reference); hook message "beads-sync: ERROR: 'bd dolt push' failed — aborting Git push".
HYPOTHESIS: schema-skew (binary v53 vs database v65) or interrupted dolt op left dangling chunks.
STEPS: upgrade bd binary to v65-compatible; run bd dolt gc / dolt integrity checks on .beads/dolt; verify bd dolt push succeeds; then remove --no-verify bypasses.
NON_GOALS: do NOT delete/rebuild the db without operator approval (history risk).
source.title: beads dolt db: dangling chunk reference blocks bd dolt push (core)
